_format: Xray Cloud GraphQL createTest mutation variables — see README.md
_note: Xray Cloud has no single bulk-JSON 'create these manual tests' REST endpoint. Each object below is a ready-to-use `variables` payload for the createTest GraphQL mutation (https://xray.cloud.getxray.app/api/v2/graphql). Run scripts/import-tests.sh to create them one call per test case.

steps.action: Open the storefront and navigate to Explore.
Count the number of chefs shown across all pages.
steps.result: Exactly the number of ACTIVE chefs (7).

steps.action: Look for the known INACTIVE seeded chef.
steps.result: That chef does not appear on any page.

steps.action: Call GET /api/chef/active?page=0&size=50 directly.
steps.result: count equals the number of ACTIVE chefs, matching the UI.

steps.action: Call GET /api/chef/active?page=0&size=3.
Record the id of every chef returned on page 0.
Call GET /api/chef/active?page=1&size=3.
steps.result: Returns 3 different chefs, no overlap with page 0.

steps.action: Call GET /api/chef/active?page=2&size=3.
steps.result: Returns the remaining active chef(s), no repeats, none missing.

steps.action: Sum ids seen across all pages against the full active chef id list.
steps.result: Every active chef id appears exactly once.

fields.summary: Pagination covers every active chef exactly once

steps.action: From Explore, open a known chef's page.
Compare displayed name and cuisine to seed data.
Compare displayed rating.
steps.result: Matches the seeded value, rounded to one decimal place.

steps.action: Compare displayed delivery fee and free-delivery threshold.
Compare displayed delivery methods.
steps.result: Match the seeded deliveryMethods for this chef.

fields.summary: Chef page header shows correct chef details

steps.action: Call GET /api/dish/tags?chefId=<id> for the chef.
Open the chef's page on the storefront.
steps.result: Menu sections appear in the same order.

steps.action: Compare dishes shown per section to GET /api/chef/{id}'s dishes[] filtered by tag.
steps.result: Only ACTIVE dishes appear, in API order.

steps.action: Confirm the known INACTIVE dish for this chef.
steps.result: It does not appear in any section.

fields.summary: Menu is grouped by tag in priority order, active dishes only

steps.action: Open a chef's menu and click a dish card.
Observe initial quantity in the modal.
Attempt to decrease below minimumOrderCount.
steps.result: Quantity does not go below the minimum.

steps.action: Increase quantity by 2 and check the line total.
Click Add to cart.
steps.result: Modal closes; cart contains this dish at the selected quantity.

fields.summary: Dish modal respects minimum order count when adding to cart

steps.action: Open the cart with one dish line at quantity 1.
Click the decrement control on that line.
Confirm removal.
steps.result: Line is removed from the cart.

steps.action: If this was the only line, observe the cart.

fields.summary: Decrementing below the minimum order count removes the cart line

steps.action: Add dishes until the subtotal exactly equals freeDeliveryFrom.
steps.result: Cart subtotal reads exactly the threshold value.

steps.action: Observe the delivery fee line for a DELIVERY order.
Proceed to checkout and place the order.
steps.result: totalPrice equals dish subtotal only, no delivery fee.

steps.action: Repeat with subtotal one unit below the threshold.
Repeat with subtotal one unit above the threshold.

fields.summary: Delivery is free once the subtotal reaches the free-delivery threshold

steps.action: Go to checkout with DELIVERY selected, leave all fields empty.
Fill city, street, building only.
Fill receiver name and phone number as well.
Clear the phone number field.
Enter an implausible phone number.
steps.result: Validation error shown; Place order stays disabled.

fields.summary: Checkout requires mandatory fields before submission is enabled

steps.action: Submit a valid order via the storefront checkout UI.
steps.result: Request sent has paymentType: CASH and succeeds.

steps.action: POST /api/order directly with paymentType: CARD.
steps.result: 400, message indicating only cash is supported.

steps.action: POST /api/order with paymentType omitted.
Confirm no order was created for the rejected attempts.
steps.result: Only the one order from step 1 exists.

fields.summary: Order creation rejects any payment type other than cash

steps.action: Place an order and note the returned order number.
Go to /tracking/<number>.
steps.result: Shows NEW status and matching items.

steps.action: In admin, move the order NEW to ACCEPTED.
Reload the tracking page.
In admin, move to DELIVERED; reload tracking.

fields.summary: Tracking page shows the order's current status by number
